03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill that builds a tracker dashboard: a vibe-dashboard page with its own owner-only database, for one Fusion add-in on its way to a public GitHub repository. It follows the shape of the Selection Inspector move tracker (Tue Nov 24, 2026).

It has two paths. Move is for an add-in that already exists: Swami uploads its zip, and the steps run Instructions, Tracker, Audit, Create repo, First release, Future releases and Field guide. New is for an add-in built in its repo from day one: Instructions, Tracker, Create repo, Build on branch dev, First release, Future releases and Field guide.

Every step has a copyable prompt, a status and a done tick saved in the page's database, so any later chat can tick a step for Swami and the page stays the one record of where the job stands.

Why it mattersMoving the Selection Inspector add-in to GitHub taught lessons worth keeping, such as shipping the update check in the very first release. This skill bakes them into a tracker Claude builds fresh for each add-in, instead of re-planning every move from scratch.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • InputsWorks out the path (an uploaded zip means move), the display and internal names, the repo name (fusion-addin-<name> under swami-claude-skills), a one-sentence description, the button location and, for a move, the uploaded version. It asks only for what it can't work out.
  • KitGets the tracker kit from Swami's private repo swami-claude-skills/vibe-dashboards, folder addin-tracker/: build_tracker.py, tracker.js, extra.css, post.py, three patch files and two sample configs.
  • ConfigWrites a small cfg.json for the add-in, such as name, internal name, description, location, start date and path.
  • BuildBuilds the page with build_tracker.py, then runs vibe-dashboard's table-fit, toolbar, Search, Mind Map, source colour and tooltip patches in a fixed order.
  • Page ContentThe step table with a prompt per step, a diagram of the whole job with a colour key, Decisions, Links that turn live, the model and planned repo layouts as collapsible trees, a 15-check Test in Fusion list and Troubleshooting.
  • ChecksLooks at the diagram for overlaps and opens the page at 1440, 1000 and 390 px: no console errors, no sideways scroll on a phone, no system tooltips, every glossary term found, and 13 sections in order.
  • AudioRecords the audio overview from the narration draft the build writes, after the noun/verb stress audit.
  • PrivacyScans the page, narration and config against the project's own exclusion list before publishing; any real hit stops the publish.
  • PublishPublishes the page with an owner-only database (steps, tests and links), checks the database, ticks step 2 done, and records the tracker link in project memory.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • From a NameStarts from just the add-in's name and works out the rest, asking only for what it can't.
  • Two PathsCovers both a move of an existing add-in and a new add-in built in its repo from day one.
  • One RecordTicks and statuses live in the page's own database, so they survive rebuilds and any chat can update them.
  • Lessons KeptBakes in what earlier moves taught: the update check ships in the first release, update-banner tests wait for the second, and the Claude GitHub app may need the new repo added.
  • Tracks, Doesn't DoIt builds the tracker; the move or build itself happens later, step by step, from the prompts on the page.
  • Private KitThe kit lives in Swami's private repo, so the skill only works on an account whose Claude GitHub app can reach that repo.
  • Owner-Only TicksOnly Swami, or Claude writing as him, can change a step's status or tick; other viewers see them read only.
  • No Fusion TestingClaude can't run the add-in in Fusion; the Test in Fusion checks are for Swami.
09Scheduled TasksRUNTIME▶

None. It runs when Swami asks for a tracker, and steps are ticked from chats. The nightly GitHub backup of Swami's artifacts also saves each tracker page, but that task is not part of this skill.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Update Check FirstThe first public release always includes the update check; a move's first release is a minor bump over the uploaded version, with no separate as-is release.
  • Banner TestsUpdate-banner checks 13 to 15 only work from the second release.
  • GitHub App AccessAdd the new repo to the Claude GitHub app before the first push (github.com/settings/installations › Claude › Repository access; GitHub confirms by email).
  • New PathMain gets no version.json until the first release, so the release workflow has nothing to publish while the add-in is built on dev.
  • RepublishingLater republishes leave the capabilities out, so the database rules and saved ticks stay. Read a database doc before changing it, since writing it replaces the whole doc.
  • Privacy TermsNever write the exclusion terms anywhere; refer to an exclusion only as "1 item excluded for privacy".
12Other RequirementsREFERENCE▶
  • Claude ProjectA Claude project for the add-in, with instructions that include its privacy exclusion list; the skill follows those instructions on top of its own.
  • GitHub AccessSwami's GitHub connected to Claude, with the private vibe-dashboards repo reachable by the Claude GitHub app.
  • Code ExecutionCode execution with network access, for the kit, the patches, the browser checks and the audio.
  • WindowsNothing extra to build a tracker: works the same from Windows 10 or 11.
